meta_description: Oakwood Plumbing Ltd in Derby offers emergency plumbing, repairs, and installations. Fast response, honest pricing, local family business. Call us today.
hero_subhead: Burst pipe or broken boiler in Derby? We arrive within the hour, any time of day or night.
services_subhead: From emergency callouts to planned installations, we handle every plumbing job with the same care and attention to detail.

services.title: Emergency Repairs
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, and blocked drains fixed fast. We carry parts on the van and aim to complete most jobs in one visit.

services.title: Boiler Repairs & Servicing
services.desc: Annual safety checks, fault diagnosis, and repairs. Keep your heating running safely and efficiently all winter.

services.title: Bathroom Installations
services.desc: Full bathroom suites, wet rooms, and shower upgrades. We manage the whole project from plumbing to tiling finish.

services.title: Central Heating Systems
services.desc: New boiler installations, radiator replacement, and system upgrades. We advise on the right system for your home and budget.

services.title: Tap & Toilet Repairs
services.desc: Dripping taps, running toilets, and water-saving upgrades. Quick fixes that cut waste and reduce your water bills.

services.title: Pipe & Radiator Work
services.desc: Frozen pipes, corrosion repairs, and radiator balancing. We diagnose issues quickly and restore your heating without fuss.

about_pullquote: I started this business to give Derby homeowners an honest plumber they could trust.
about_para_1: Oakwood Plumbing was founded in 2006 and has served Derby and surrounding areas ever since. We've grown from a one-man operation to a small, tightly-knit team—all of us trained to the same high standard. Every member of the team lives locally, so we know Derby inside out and pride ourselves on quick response times and straightforward pricing.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on showing up when we say we will, explaining the problem clearly, and charging a fair price with no hidden extras. We listen to what you need and suggest solutions that match your budget. Many of our customers have used us for years and happily recommend us to their neighbours—that word-of-mouth trust means everything to us.
reviews_heading: What Derby Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Woke up at 2am to find water dripping from the kitchen ceiling. Called Oakwood and someone was here by 3. Mark found the leak in the bathroom upstairs, fixed it properly, and didn't overcharge. Really impressed. Will use them again for sure.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Had our boiler serviced last month. The engineer was on time, knew what he was doing, and explained everything clearly. At that price, I was half expecting cowboys, but they're just honest and professional. Definitely booking with them again next year.
reviews.author: Helen M.

reviews.text: New radiators fitted in our lounge. The lads were tidy, worked quickly, and made sure everything was left spotless. Quoted £800, charged £800—no surprises. That's rare these days. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Paul S.
